title: Dual partially harmonic tensors and quantized Schur--Weyl duality
summary: Let $V$ be a $2m$-dimensional symplectic space over an infinite field $K$. Let $\mathfrak{B}^{(f)}_{n,K}$ be the two-sided ideal of the Birman--Murakami--Wenzl algebra $\mathfrak{B}_{n,K}$ generated by $E_1E_3\cdots E_{2f-1}$ with $1\leq f\leq\left\lfloor \frac n2 \right\rfloor$. In this paper, using the diagram category of framed tangles and canonical basis, we prove that the natural homomorphism from $\mathfrak{B}_{n,K}/\mathfrak{B}^{(f)}_{n,K}$ to $ \mathrm{End}_{U_q(\mathfrak{sp}_{2m})}\left(V^{\otimes n}/\left(V^{\otimes n}\cdot \mathfrak{B}^{(f)}_{n,K}\right)\right)$ is always…
